title: The emptied stem
direction: Wordmark-led: an engineered grotesque cut at one flat angle on every stroke ending; the final l of the double ll is drawn hollow, present but emptied.
rationale: For a coined name the word is the identity. The ll pair is this name's own opportunity: two parallel stems, one solid, one emptied, says null and also still there, restorable from the Trash.
semantics: null value; emptied but not destroyed; Trash-first safety; terminal precision

pitch.idea: MacNull set in a heavy engineered grotesque where every stem top is cut at one rising angle and the final l is left hollow: present but emptied, the way a cleaned file still sits in the Trash, and the icon pair reads both as ll and as a 1 next to a 0.
strengths: the move comes from this name's own letters (the double ll), so it is ownable and needs no explanation
one chisel angle on every free stem top (M, N, u, l) makes the whole word read as drawn, not typeset
the icon has a developer double reading (1 and 0, set and null) without being a letter in a tile
weaknesses: the hollow l thins to a grey stroke below about 16 px cap height, where the word reads as plain MacNull
the icon pair could still be taken for a 10 or two buildings before it is seen as ll
on light paper the mint signal colour lacks contrast, so the master is graphite-only and mint lives on dark grounds
